subject: Aisleway exec intro — VP/CIO briefing + demo (recording ok?)

Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’d like to lock a short executive intro + demo with our VP (Catherine Lin) and CIO (Tomasz Baran). This would be a compact 30–40 minute session: 15–20 minute product demo focused on latency/cost controls, then 10–15 minutes for policy/security Q&A.

Two windows that work for our execs next week (Europe time):
- Tues 2026-12-30 16:00–16:40 CET
- Wed 2026-12-31 09:00–09:40 CET

Can you confirm whether Redwood is okay with recording the demo (we’ll be sharing internally) and whether a short dry run is advisable? Also: we attached an org chart and a short list of initial security questions to this thread.

Att: Aisleway_OrgChart.pdf
Att: Aisleway_Security_Questions.xlsx

Thanks,

Jordan —

Appreciate the clarity. Either window works on our side but I’d recommend Tue 2026-12-30 16:00 CET so we can follow up before year-end if needed. Recording is fine; please confirm that the recording will remain internal to Aisleway.

Attendees from Redwood (planned):
- Markus Klein (you — host/demo)
- Kimberly Park (security & compliance backup)
- Jordan Blake (solutions engineer — product deep dive)

Quick asks so we’re prepared:
- Can you confirm the exec titles & the business priorities you want us to emphasize? (cost per inference, latency SLA, private deployment options?)
- Any preferred deliverables after the call (one-pager, security checklist answers)?

We can put a 30-minute calendar hold and add a 15-minute dry run slot earlier the same day if that helps. I’ll wait on your confirmation and then send an invite with the recording consent language.

Cheers,
Markus

Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus — Tue 2026-12-30 16:00 CET works. Confirmed attendees: Catherine Lin (VP Product), Tomasz Baran (CIO), plus our Head of Procurement on standby in case there are any procurement/contract questions that surface.

Priority asks for the session:
- Show how Redwood reduces token spend for bursty inference patterns and options for dedicated capacity commitments;
- Quick walk through the private deployment controls and KMS integration;
- Brief on rollback/fallback policies for reliability during peak windows.

Recording consent: yes, recording will be internal only.

Attachments: I’m re-attaching the org chart and a short security questions spreadsheet for your CS/infosec review.

Attachment: Aisleway_OrgChart.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Aisleway_Security_Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you could share a demo deck and the Redwood security checklist answers before the session that would be great — we’ll circulate to Catherine and Tomasz.

Best,
Jordan

We will cover the three priority areas you listed. Pre-reads being shared today:
- Redwood exec demo deck (attached)
- Short security checklist (answers grid)

Dry run: we’ve scheduled a 20-minute run-through at 2026-12-30 14:30 CET (internal only) — Kimberly will lead the security Q&A, Jordan Blake will own the demo flow. If your VP/CIO would like to join the dry run that’s welcome but not required.

Attachments (sent): Redwood_Demo_Deck.pdf, Redwood_Security_Checklist_Answers.xlsx

Notes for calendaring: we’ll mark the meeting as recorded (internal to Aisleway) and set the meeting options so only presenters can share. If procurement raises any redlines after the session we’ll coordinate next steps via your procurement contact.

—Markus
